steps.name: Insufficient Energy (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Rapidem] in “Monster Tree Mountain,” go to [Pulse] in “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I just want to thank you for helping me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing? Then please tell me... . Ah, this isn’t my way of speaking… . Anyway, I can't just pass it by.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Thanks Maui. Thanks to your help, the mountain's spirit has returned to some extent, but it still seems not enough.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Hey, you know what? This monster tree mountain is the center of the natural power that flows through Myrgandia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure, but you're saying that if there isn't enough energy, there's a high chance that Mirgandia will be contaminated?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That's right. We need a way to unleash the spirit of the mountain more clearly and cleanly. Only then will it be safe here too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will help Iris become a more complete god.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The goddess has her own difficulties, so don’t push her too hard. All you need to do is help me.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Originally, if you gave power to a rock and made a flower bloom, the spirit around the mountain would become clean. But as time goes by, all kinds of contaminants increase, and with this incident... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The big guy couldn't do it with just flowers. If you know a wizard who does a lot of research, go and get their advice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's a wizard who does a lot of research... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't know, but it seems like there was someone in the city you visited who was greedy for magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. there is. But how did you know that?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Since I have been on the land for a long time, there is some information that flows into the land. Hehehe. They say it's the power of spirits.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Ah, I have a plan... . You say it. This is not urgent, so take your time.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oh, and by the way. Don't tell me who I am. An old man said he was having headaches because the mountain was polluted and asked for help. Got it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Thank you. See you later then.

steps.name: Insufficient Energy (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Ranatun] in “Ra’s Castle” and obtain <Cursed Heart>. Then report to [Pulse] in the “Underground City of Tartarus”.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: (Pulse is reading a book without realizing there is a person in front of him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. excuse me… .

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: What's going on? I'm in the middle of reading a new book, so I'm interrupted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I might have brought something that could be helpful to your research.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Then I will listen and judge.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As requested by Lapidem, an old man says that his mountain is polluted and he wants to purify it with magical power.)

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: If it's a mountain that requires magical help, it's probably not an ordinary mountain.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Research into magic that purifies nature... . I've always wanted to give it a try, but I never thought I'd get a chance like this.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I will try it, so please help me get the special materials needed for the research. If it were ordinary materials, the gems here would be enough... .

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: This is research that requires combination and convergence. It might feel like some kind of alchemy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what ingredients do you need?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: According to records, there is an object called the <Cursed Heart> that can control the power of life.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I think it's somewhere in the desert of Eastland... . First, bring the ingredients and then we'll talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I know where it is. It's a bit annoying, but... .

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Then we will wait. This looks like it would be an interesting study.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: You've found the ingredients. Thank you for your effort

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you waited long?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: No. You came just on time.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: It's a mysterious object just by looking at it. Then, I would like you to wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: (Pulse shows a faint smile and disappears somewhere with the ingredients.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Seeing how different he is from usual, I'm sure he's a person good at studying magic.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: (A huge explosion suddenly occurs in the alley where the pulse disappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was definitely a building with Pulse in it... ,

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: (Pulse slowly walks out, looking mangled in the aftermath of the explosion.)

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: My theory was perfect... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: My theory was perfect... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, pulse... . Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I'm fine... , I don’t know what part was wrong with the study.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: We considered all variables such as mana flow, but failed... . There is no shame.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: They even made the ingredients you brought useless... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So will we get it again?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: No. Even if I do it now, I think my results will still be explosive. ha… .

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Honestly, I'm in a state of panic. I hate to admit it, but he might give me a better answer than me.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: As you probably know from Luman, that person is Miss Asma. Go and say Pulse is sorry, just say one thing and ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I just say that?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Yes, that's it. Miss Asuma doesn't usually do things like this, but she will do it for you. Of course, he will show a different expression than usual... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since you said that, I'll go see Asuma.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Yes, thank you. Then I'll have to clean up the room that was a mess from the explosion. I don't know what Mr. Melvik will nag if I just leave him alone... .

steps.name: Insufficient Energy (4)
steps.objective: Obtain <Roots of the Vitality Tree>, <Tear of Vegetation>, and report them to [Asuma] of "Lu Man".

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, hello. Asma. It's no different. I came today because I have a favor to ask you.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes, go ahead. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is also something that Pulse asked me to say.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Pulse? Is this Pulse in Tartarus now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Asuma’s face seems to have hardened for a moment...)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: It’s not what you think♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I got it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Asma is told by an old man that his mountain is polluted and that he wants to clean it with magical powers and needs his help.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pulse says she's sorry she couldn't do this.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Pulse isn't sorry about that. So don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Don't worry♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, yes... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Obviously the atmosphere has suddenly become cold. I just need to keep quiet.)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: It's difficult to explain in detail, but I think there was a slight change when Adventurer received the materials.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if it’s a change?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Adventurer's power is outside of the normal state, so it seems that the material was also affected.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: That's either good or bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . So that's my problem. I'm the one who has to apologize to Pulse.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Never mind. You probably already know Pulse. Although his theory was not wrong, he found out about the variable Adventurer too late.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Instead, please get the ingredients and bring them to me. First, I would like to ask for <Roots of the Vitality Tree> and <Tears of Vegetation>.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will rescue you somehow.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Then I'll ask you a favor.

steps.name: Insufficient Energy (5)
steps.objective: Obtain <Spirit Soul> and <Origin of Wind> and report them to [Rapidem] at “Monster Tree Mountain.”

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: You've found the ingredients.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Well done. Actually, this is not an ingredient that helps the energy of the mountain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? So what material is it?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Please listen first. Even if you go to the mountain to get new materials, you may not be able to use them again due to Adventurer's condition on the way.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I'll make you a kind of medicine that will prevent those changes. It won't take long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: (Asuma, who had gone inside, appears holding a bag of medicine.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not like you're going to get weird after eating it, right?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The theory is perfect, so don't worry too much. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That makes me even more anxious. Phew, I'll just try it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is it delicious? What medicine makes it taste like meat?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: That's a relief. If it were a side effect, it would have tasted different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that... .

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Hehe, don't worry too much. Anyway, I need more ingredients.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll forgive it because it tastes like meat. Phew… . So what more ingredients do you need to get?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Obtain <Spirit Soul> from a dungeon on Merin Island and <Origin of Wind> from the 'Hall of Rest' in the Amalun Desert.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are many places to go.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Adventurer can do it all. When you have collected all the items, bring them to the spirit elder.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, did you know?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes, I heard it from Mir. Sometimes he comes to pick up beef jerky, and then he meets me. As we talked, we heard a story about an elderly spirit.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: He said he was concerned about making the mountains clearer, so I was looking into it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Thanks to you, it became easier.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: What? Everything Adventurer does is for the good of the continent and the world, so it's natural to help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Asuma.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes, please be careful.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I felt a tremendous energy from the entrance of the mountain, so I asked someone and it turned out to be you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have been there.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The things you're holding could be helpful to me. Could you please put some in front of me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The person who told me said I could collect these items and take them to Lapidem.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What is it? Is there a wizard who knows me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Lapidem that Mir met Asma and said that.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I will tell you when the child comes. The spirit of this mountain was talking about blah blah blah, and I remember it.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It's so amazing. Next time I come, I'll tell the kids on the mountain to prepare something delicious.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: By the way, the wizard who taught me this is really amazing. You are lucky and have many blessings. It would be better to treat it with respect.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Then I'll put my power into these things.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (A wind blows from somewhere over the ingredients in front of Lapidem. The wind soon turns sharp and breaks the ingredients into powder.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (The powdered materials are carried by the wind, sparkling in the air and flying all over Mirgandia, including the mountains.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… . I feel like the air has become clearer.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I am grateful. This is my role given by the Goddess.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I hope nothing special happens in this world from now on... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing will happen. Then I'll go take care of the rest.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Draw it. Well then, good luck.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You may not know this, but there is a lot of work to be done. Please be careful... .
